command:
set -eu
BASE=/workspace/omega_runtime/extensions/ingress_v2
TOKEN=/workspace/omega_runtime/private/ingress-gabriel.token
LOG=/workspace/omega_runtime/state/logs/ingress_gateway_v2.log
umask 077
tmux has-session -t omega-ingress
tmux new-session -d -s omega-ingress-candidate "cd $BASE && PYTHONPATH=. exec python3 -m omega.ingress_gateway serve --owner gabriel --machine omega-vps --port 8788 >>$LOG 2>&1"
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,time
from pathlib import Path
t=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/private/ingress-gabriel.token').read_text().strip()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8788/v1/health',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+t})
for i in range(10):
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=2) as r:
   print('CANDIDATE_HEALTH',r.status);break
 except Exception:
  time.sleep(.3)
else:raise AssertionError('candidate health check failed')
PY
tmux kill-session -t omega-ingress-candidate
tmux kill-session -t omega-ingress
tmux new-session -d -s omega-ingress "cd $BASE && PYTHONPATH=. exec python3 -m omega.ingress_gateway serve --owner gabriel --machine omega-vps --port 8787 >>$LOG 2>&1"
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,time,json
from pathlib import Path
t=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/private/ingress-gabriel.token').read_text().strip()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/health',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+t})
for i in range(15):
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=2) as r:
   print('ACTIVE_V2_HEALTH',r.status,json.loads(r.read().decode()));break
 except Exception:
  time.sleep(.4)
else:
 raise AssertionError('active v2 health failed; re-activate v1 from extensions/ingress_v1')
PY
